digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 and batch runner usage instrumentation
propositions: Pass-1 functions discard per-call _usage dicts from runner results, blocking token totals and per-criterion request counts in batch outputs and coverage metrics
Usage data must be threaded through the entire call chain (sizing → pass1_with_ladder → passes.pass1_chunk/container/isf) as return-value pairs to aggregate tokens and attribute them per criterion

Multi-criterion single-turn chunks must divide token fields equally across criteria while counting llm_calls in full per criterion; ladder retries each contribute a call record; raising attempts and checkpoint-cached chunks contribute nothing
The sidecar payload must expose coverage.usage with per_call records (criteria lists, token counts) and per_criterion attribution maps under those exact keys
All external callers of modified pass functions and run_focused_finder (eval_solver, criterion_preview, fidelity_spot_eval, prerequisites) must be updated atomically to unpack the new return shapes
